cipher.name: KeyboardColumnShiftCipher
cipher.idea: A highly intuitive keyboard-based substitution cipher where each letter is replaced by the letter directly below it on a standard QWERTY keyboard layout. If a letter is on the bottom row, it wraps around to the top row in the same vertical column. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
We define 10 vertical columns based on the standard QWERTY keyboard layout:
Column 1: Q -> A -> Z -> Q
Column 2: W -> S -> X -> W
Column 3: E -> D -> C -> E
Column 4: R -> F -> V -> R
Column 5: T -> G -> B -> T
Column 6: Y -> H -> N -> Y
Column 7: U -> J -> M -> U
Column 8: I -> K -> I (Since there is no letter below K, K wraps to I)
Column 9: O -> L -> O (Since there is no letter below L, L wraps to O)
Column 10: P -> P (P stays P as it has no letters below it in its column)

To encrypt:
- Convert each letter to the letter directly below it in its column (wrapping to the top of the column if it is at the bottom).
- Preserve the original case (e.g., 'q' -> 'a', 'Q' -> 'A').
- All non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
To decrypt, reverse the column shift by moving one step up in the column:
Column 1: Q -> Z -> A -> Q
Column 2: W -> X -> S -> W
Column 3: E -> C -> D -> E
Column 4: R -> V -> F -> R
Column 5: T -> B -> G -> T
Column 6: Y -> N -> H -> Y
Column 7: U -> M -> J -> U
Column 8: I -> K -> I
Column 9: O -> L -> O
Column 10: P -> P

- Convert each letter to the letter directly above it in its column (wrapping to the bottom of the column if it is at the top).
- Preserve the original case.
- All non-alphabetic characters remain completely unchanged.
